== Objectives ==
Speak to Marrek Stromnur inside Anvilmar.
* [[Glyphic Rune]]

== Description ==
While you were helping me out, this glyph was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the mage trainer Marrek. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.

==Rewards==
You will receive:
* 40 XP

== Progress ==
Yeah, what's that? Speak up, if you don't mind. I don't hear so good after a few ales.

== Completion ==
Here's what you need to know: Don't get into too much trouble. Save some coin to buy me an ale... or any spells ya might want. I'll be here if you need me or want to train... or whatever.
